```yaml
name: Update Ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    # Check for new releases every day at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  check-and-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Get current ingestr version
        id: current_version
        run: |
          # Extract the current version from the Go file where ingestrVersion is defined
          # Assuming it's in a constant or variable assignment like: ingestrVersion = "v1.2.3"
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'ingestrVersion\s*=\s*"\K[^"]+' internal/ingestr/version.go || echo "v0.0.0")
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Current version found: $CURRENT_VERSION"

      - name: Get latest ingestr release
        id: latest_release
        run: |
          # Fetch the latest release tag from the ingestr repository
          # Assuming the ingestr repo is bruin-data/ingestr
          LATEST_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Latest version found: $LATEST_TAG"

      - name: Compare versions
        id: compare
        run: |
          CURRENT="${{ steps.current_version.outputs.current_version }}"
          LATEST="${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          
          # Remove 'v' prefix for comparison if present
          CURRENT_NUM="${CURRENT#v}"
          LATEST_NUM="${LATEST#v}"
          
          if [ "$CURRENT_NUM" != "$LATEST_NUM" ]; then
            echo "new_version_found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "New version available: $LATEST (current: $CURRENT)"
          else
            echo "new_version_found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "No new version available."
          fi

      - name: Update ingestr version
        if: steps.compare.outputs.new_version_found == 'true'
        run: |
          LATEST="${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          # Update the version in the Go file
          sed -i "s/ingestrVersion\s*=\s*\"[^\"]*\"/ingestrVersion = \"$LATEST\"/" internal/ingestr/version.go
          echo "Updated ingestrVersion to $LATEST"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.compare.outputs.new_version_found == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump ingestr version to ${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          title: "chore: bump ingestr version to ${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the ingestr version to ${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}.
            
            Automated by the update-ingestr workflow.
          branch: "bump-ingestr-${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automated-pr
            dependencies
```
